title: System context: Delivery Platform
prompt: Model a food-delivery platform in the Structurizr DSL: a Customer (a `person`) who uses your own software system called "Delivery Platform". The Delivery Platform in turn depends on an external software system called "Payment Gateway" to process card payments over a synchronous call — tag the Payment Gateway system "External". Add a views block. Run `structurizrx validate --strict` before you consider it done.
